channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Elon Musk Slams Apple-Google Gemini Deal, Warns of ‘Unreasonable Concentration of Power’
item.description: Tesla CEO and founder of AI firm xAI, Elon Musk, on Tuesday sharply criticised Apple’s decision to adopt Google’s Gemini models for next‑generation Siri and Apple Foundation Models, calling it “an unreasonable concentration of power” for Google.

item.title: Gunshots fired at Delhi gym; Lawrence Bishnoi gang ‘claims’ responsibility
item.description: The incident occurred around 11 p.m. on Monday when two bike-borne assailants allegedly fired two rounds in the air outside the gym, 'RK Fitness', located on the Outer Ring Road in Paschim Vihar, officials said.

item.title: Olympic Medalist Aman Sehrawat Inspires Young Wrestlers in Mumbai
item.description: Mumbai experienced a vibrant blend of tradition and modern sports enthusiasm as Olympic bronze medalist Aman Sehrawat wrapped up a one-day youth and akhada outreach tour across the city.

item.title: Allu Arjun reaches Tokyo ahead of ‘Pushpa 2’ release in Japan
item.description: Before Allu Arjun's blockbuster hit "Pushpa: The Rule" release in Japan on January 16, the 'Stylish Star' has reached Tokyo to promote his action entertainer in the country.

item.title: No Mayor in Mumbai without Congress’ support, says Varsha Gaikwad
item.description: As the battle for the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) intensifies, Mumbai Regional Congress Committee (MRCC) President and MP Varsha Gaikwad has made a bold claim regarding the post of the city's Mayor.

item.title: Intoxicated man beats father over money dispute in Mumbai
item.description: The accused son, identified as Mohammad Shahid Yaqub Chaudhary (42), allegedly intercepted his father, Mohammad Yaqub Mohammad Siddique Chaudhary, a resident of Roshan Chawl in the Jarimari area, near Kadri Line Lane.

item.title: Govt employees protest in Balochistan, seeking 30 pc disparity reduction allowance
item.description: Government employees held protests in Pakistan's Balochistan, demanding the implementation of the Disparity Reduction Allowance (DRA), leading to road blockades and arrests, local media reported.

item.title: ‘Mumbai Belongs to Everyone’: Nawab Malik Rejects Divisive Politics
item.description: NCP leader Nawab Malik on Tuesday accused the BJP, Shiv Sena(UBT) and the MNS of polarising the civic body elections and playing with the emotions of the public, claiming that people have understood that real issues are not being raised by these political parties.

item.title: Telangana CM moots auto-debit system for traffic challans
item.description: He asked the traffic police to link the vehicles to the bank accounts of the owners at the time of the registration of vehicles, so that whenever a challan is issued, the money should be deducted from the bank accounts.

item.title: Nobody Expected It’: Farah Khan on the Rise of Andaaz Apna Apna
item.description: Filmmaker-choreographer Farah Khan has candidly shared that she never imagined cult comedy “Andaaz Apna Apna” would go on to earn its iconic status, revealing that she had actually predicted the film would fail at the box office.
